mechanism: Benazepril can potentiate the hypotensive effects of prochlorperazine, and prochlorperazine may inhibit benazepril's antihypertensive efficacy through alpha-blocking activity; both drugs can cause orthostatic hypotension and dizziness.
action: Monitor blood pressure regularly, counsel patients on orthostatic hypotension precautions, and adjust dosing if needed; consider alternative antiemetic if hypotension becomes problematic.
